stong pa'i ngang las bhandha'i snod du hūm̐ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma sha khrag gi phung po 'dod yon gyi rol mo cir yang 'char ba zag pa med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/
snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bka' skyong 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badzra kī la ya dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi// bka' yi srung mar dam bcas shing*// dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i g.yar dam can// shwa na bzhi dang bdag nyid ma// sa bdag chen mo mched bzhi dang*// bse lcags dung gi skyes bu bzhi// dam can srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs mthun rdzas mchod gtor bzhes// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen spel// rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// sarba gatstshaḥ
mnyam nyid chos dbang gi bskul ngor dharma swa mis spel//
